scope: Pinned live host interfaces, canonical launch contracts, qualified selection observations, and owned POSIX process/workspace cleanup
qualification_rule: Every requested case and trial must complete, remain canonically valid, and carry a qualified observation under the pinned preflight and launch contract

claude.selection_observation: Completed linked model-initiated Skill call plus exact post-selection nonce attestation
authoritative_fields: system/init skills, tools, plugins, mcp_servers, model
user message.content tool_result tool_use_id and is_error
selection_contract: Exact staged target or sibling Skill identifier
No malformed, unknown, multiple, or competing selection
One exact target nonce as the first nonblank line after target selection
configuration_contract: Pinned CLI version and required flags
Empty user, project, and local setting sources
No remote or filesystem managed settings, MCP, or instructions
No macOS managed preference payload when running on macOS
claude.retry_contract: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES=0 and any reported api_retry invalidates the stream
claude.model_contract: Exact claude-sonnet-5 request; conflicting native init or assistant model identities are invalid
claude.direct_invocation: UserPromptExpansion is outside the implicit-selection measurement scope and is not qualified by this record

codex.interface: codex exec --json with pseudo-terminal-isolated positional input, strict isolated config, and a dedicated no-retry ChatGPT-auth provider
codex.selection_observation: Proven exact staged SKILL.md body read plus that skill's unique first-line marker
authoritative_fields: command_execution command, status, aggregated_output, and exit_code
selection_contract: One started and successfully completed command bound by item id
Command names the exact staged target or sibling SKILL.md path
Command output equals the exact complete staged body, or a qualified shell command begins with sed -n 1,240p of the exact path and its output begins with that complete body
A leading compound read tail cannot name another staged path or emit any staged body or marker
At most one known marker, first in its completed agent message
A marker is valid only when corroborated by its matching body read
configuration_contract: Pinned CLI version and required flags
Strict config and ignored user config
Unrelated skills, MCP servers, and features disabled
Catalog readiness and exact target/sibling descriptions
Fresh pseudo-terminal on fd 0 prevents non-terminal stdin prompt appends
codex.retry_contract: request_max_retries=0, stream_max_retries=0, supports_websockets=false, and unbounded_connection_retries disabled
unavailable_public_fields: Reported backend model identity in thread.started or turn.started
Provider behavior invisible to the configured public client interface
codex.outer_exit_source: Python supervisor Popen.returncode; never inferred from a turn event
codex.model_contract: Exact gpt-5.6-sol/low request; public exec JSON provides request-only rather than resolved backend identity evidence
codex.direct_invocation: Forced direct invocation is outside the implicit-selection measurement scope and is not qualified by this record

retry_contract.harness: No automatic relaunch; stop after the first invalid trial
retry_contract.reported_provider_retries: Reported retry or error events invalidate the stream
retry_contract.configured_provider_retries: Disabled through each pinned host's supported controls
retry_contract.invisible_provider_behavior: Not reconstructed or claimed beyond the configured public interface

cleanup_contract.posix: Bounded termination and absence check of the original owned process group
cleanup_contract.windows: Not qualified because direct-child cleanup is insufficient for the required descendant scope
cleanup_contract.workspace: Separate post-run cleanup receipt and runner exit
